DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遊具の案内をご覧になっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the playground information, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 四歳の子と来ました。この大きな遊具には六歳からと書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四歳の子の遊具対象年齢を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came with a four-year-old. Does this large piece of equipment say ages six and up?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm the equipment's target age for a four-year-old child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。こちらは六歳以上が対象です。小さいお子さん用は奥にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, this is for ages six and older. Equipment for younger children is farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の低い滑り台へ行きます。砂場も同じ区画でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 低い滑り台を選び砂場の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will go to the low slide farther in. Is the sandbox in the same area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the low slide and ask where the sandbox is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 滑り台の隣にあります。今は清掃が終わって、使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is beside the slide. Cleaning has finished, so it is available now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 砂場の道具は持ってきました。使ったあとに洗う所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参道具を洗う場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We brought sandbox tools. Is there somewhere to wash them after use?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where to wash the tools you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 砂場の横に道具洗い場があります。飲み水用の蛇口とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a tool-washing station beside the sandbox, separate from the drinking-water tap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 道具洗い場を使います。大人が座れる場所から、砂場が見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 専用洗い場を選び見守り席の視界を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will use the tool-washing station. Can you see the sandbox from somewhere adults can sit?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the dedicated washing area and ask about the view from a supervising seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 近くのベンチから見えます。お子さんの動きが見える場所にお座りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can see it from the nearby bench. Please sit where you can see your child's movements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず低い滑り台で遊び、そのあと砂場へ行きます。終わったら道具を洗って持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 遊ぶ順と道具の洗浄持帰りを決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will play on the low slide first, then use the sandbox. When finished, we will wash the tools and take them home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide the order of play and to wash and take the tools home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28216-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ楽しくお過ごしください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 明日のご乗車についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about taking the train tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝五時半に来ます。その時間は窓口が開いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 五時半の窓口営業を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I will come at five thirty in the morning. Is the counter open then?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the counter is open at five thirty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 窓口は六時からですが、券売機は使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The counter opens at six, but you can use the ticket machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現金で切符を買う予定です。券売機は紙幣も使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金で買うと伝え使用紙幣を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to buy a ticket with cash. Does the machine accept notes too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will pay cash and ask which notes are accepted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 千円札が使えます。大きな紙幣の両替は、その時間にはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can use 1,000-yen notes. We cannot change large notes at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千円札を用意します。券売機の操作が分からないときは、誰に聞けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 千円札準備を決め操作の相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will prepare 1,000-yen notes. If I do not understand the machine, whom should I ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to prepare 1,000-yen notes and ask whom to consult about the machine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械の横の通話ボタンで、案内の担当につながります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The call button beside the machine connects you to information staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅員さんがいなくても、通話で聞けるのですね。改札も五時半に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遠隔案内を理解し早朝改札の入場を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I can ask by intercom even without a station employee there. Can I enter the gates at five thirty too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge remote guidance and confirm early-morning gate access. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 改札は始発前に開きます。五時半なら入場できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The gates open before the first train. You can enter at five thirty.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千円札を持って、券売機で買います。迷ったら通話ボタンで聞いてから入場します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙幣準備と購入と必要時の通話を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring 1,000-yen notes and buy from the machine. If unsure, I will use the call button before entering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to prepare notes, buy a ticket, and call if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 明日もお気をつけて。ご利用をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care tomorrow too. We look forward to seeing you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越しに伴うご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a consultation related to moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。水道を使い始める届出は、ここでできるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水道利用開始の届出先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Can I submit a notification to start using water here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to notify the start of water service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 水道の担当をご案内します。使い始める日は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will direct you to the water staff. Have you decided when to start using it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 鍵を受け取るのは来週月曜ですが、住むのは金曜からです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵受取日と入居日を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I receive the keys next Monday, but I will live there from Friday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the key handover date from the moving-in date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掃除などで水を使う日を、開始日として担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Consult the staff about using the day you need water for cleaning or similar work as the start date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 月曜に掃除をするので、月曜から使いたいです。名義は住む私の名前で相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 掃除に合わせ月曜開始と本人名義を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will clean on Monday, so I would like water from Monday. I will ask to have it in my name as the resident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request Monday activation for cleaning and your own name as user. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住所と部屋番号が分かる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a document showing the address and room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書があります。家主の名前と私の名前が両方載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人と家主の名前が載る契約書を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the contract. It lists both the landlord's name and mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the contract with your name and the landlord's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に、ご自身が利用者になることをお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the staff that you will be the user.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 契約書を持って、月曜開始と私の名義で相談します。水道の窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 契約書を持ち開始日と利用者を担当へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will bring the contract and ask for Monday activation in my name. I will go to the water counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bring the contract and discuss the start date and user with the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの廊下の先です。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: It is at the end of this corridor. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待合室でのご案内についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the announcements in the waiting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 人の多い所で名前を呼ばれるのが気になります。番号で呼んでもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待合室の名前呼出しを番号にしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I feel uncomfortable having my name called where there are many people. Could you call my number instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a number instead of a name in the waiting room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察の呼出しは受付番号で行えます。受付票をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can call you for consultation by reception number. Do you have your reception slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、四十八番です。画面に番号が出たら診察室へ行くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付番号を示し表示後の行動を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, number forty-eight. I go to the consultation room when my number appears on the screen, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your reception number and confirm what to do after it appears. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。診察室の番号も横に表示されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The room number appears beside it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。画面が見やすい席へ移って待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号画面が見える席への移動を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I would like to move to a seat where the screen is easy to see and wait there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request moving to a seat with a view of the number display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの列の席から見えます。移動したあとも受付票をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can see it from this row. Keep your reception slip with you after moving too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この席へ移ります。診察室に入ったあとは、名前を言う必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席を選び室内での本人確認を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move to this seat. Once inside the consultation room, do I need to say my name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose a seat and ask about identity confirmation inside the room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 室内では、ご本人の確認のためお名前を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Inside, we will ask your name to confirm your identity.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 室内での確認には答えます。待合室では四十八番と診察室の表示を見て待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 室内確認に応じ番号と診察室表示を見て待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will answer the identity check inside. In the waiting room, I will watch for number forty-eight and the room display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree to the indoor identity check and wait while watching the number and room display. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望を共有しました。どうぞこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have shared your preference. Please wait here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご近所のことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having a problem in your neighborhood?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜、隣の犬が長く鳴きます。直接話す前に、相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 隣家の夜間の犬の鳴き声の相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The neighbor's dog barks for a long time at night. Before speaking directly, I want to know whom to consult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult about the neighbor's dog's nighttime barking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今、何か危険な様子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there any dangerous situation at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 危険は見ていません。二週間ほど、夜中に一時間くらい鳴いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 危険未確認と二週間の発生状況を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not seen any danger. For about two weeks, it has been barking for about an hour in the middle of the night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not seen danger and describe the two-week situation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 犬の飼育に関する相談は、市の担当にもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also consult the city staff about dog keeping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 市の担当へ話すとき、飼い主の名前が分からなくても相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飼い主名なしで市へ相談できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: When talking to the city, can I consult even without knowing the owner's name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can consult the city without the owner's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かる範囲で、家の位置と時間帯を説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Explain the location of the house and the times as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所の地図と、鳴いていた日のメモがあります。そちらを持って相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図と日時記録を持って相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a map of the address and notes on the days it barked. I will bring those to the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will consult with a map and date-and-time notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その資料で状況を伝えられます。市の相談先をこちらに書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Those materials can convey the situation. I will write the city contact here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 相談先を受け取ります。名前を調べに行かず、分かる場所と記録を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談先を受け取り既知の位置と記録で相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the contact details. Rather than going to find the name, I will explain the known location and records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the contact and decide to consult using the known location and records. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お店からの商品発送ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending merchandise from your shop, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。差出人に店の名前を書きたいです。私の氏名も必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 差出人屋号と本人氏名の必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to put the shop name as sender. Is my personal full name needed too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the trade name as sender and whether your full name is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達できなかったときに戻せるよう、住所と受け取る方が分かる表記にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Include the address and a clear recipient for returns so it can be returned if delivery fails.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所は自宅兼店舗です。屋号の下に、自分の名字と名前を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅兼店舗住所と屋号の下の氏名を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The address is both my home and shop. I will write my surname and given name under the shop name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the combined home-shop address and your full name below the trade name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように分けると分かりやすいです。返送先の郵便番号もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Separating them that way is clear. Also check the return address's postal code.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号を書きました。電話番号は店で受ける携帯電話にしていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 郵便番号を記入し店の携帯番号使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have written the code. Can I use the mobile number I answer at the shop as the telephone number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Enter the postal code and ask to use the shop's mobile number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡を受けられる番号をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write a number where you can be contacted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 店の番号を書きます。伝票の控えは、自分の店の発送記録として残せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店番号を選び控えの発送記録利用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write the shop number. Can I keep the receipt copy as my shop's shipping record?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the shop number and ask to use the copy as a shipping record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えをお渡しします。発送した日と番号を記録しておくと整理しやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will give you a copy. Recording the shipping date and number makes it easier to organize.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 屋号、氏名、住所、店の番号を確認しました。この伝票で送り、控えを発送帳に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四項目を照合し発送と控えの保管を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the trade name, personal name, address and shop number. I will send it with this label and put the copy in the shipping ledger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the four items and decide to send and keep the copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お荷物をお預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take your parcel. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードのお取引のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a card transaction, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の買い物が、画面では二件になっています。店のレシートは一枚だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一枚のレシートに対する二件の取引表示を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yesterday's shopping appears as two transactions on the screen. I only have one receipt from the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss two transactions showing against a single receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額と、表示されている日時を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me see the amounts and the dates and times displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらも千五百円です。時刻は三分ほど違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同額と三分違いの時刻を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Both are 1,500 yen. The times are about three minutes apart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the same amount and times three minutes apart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確定前の表示かどうかも含め、カードの担当が調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The card staff will investigate, including whether the display is before final settlement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 店では最初の操作をやり直したと言われました。その説明も伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 店の操作やり直し説明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The shop told me it redid the first operation. I would like to pass on that explanation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Relay the shop's explanation that it repeated the operation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その内容を添えて担当へ引き継ぎます。レシートはこちらですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will include that information when handing over to the staff. This is the receipt, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。片方を取り消したいですが、今ここで返金が決まるわけではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 取消し希望と担当確認後の返金判断を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I want one canceled, but that does not mean a refund is decided here now, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm your cancellation request and that a refund is judged after the staff checks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が取引の状態を確認してから、対応を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will explain what can be done after checking the transaction status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二件の画面とレシートを担当に見せます。連絡を受ける電話番号も渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 画面とレシートと連絡先を担当へ提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show them the two transactions on the screen and the receipt. I will also give a phone number for contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the staff the screen, receipt and contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、カードの担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will direct you to the card staff, then. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お買い上げ品の配達をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like delivery of your purchases?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。平日は留守なので、土曜日に玄関で受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 平日不在のため土曜日の玄関手渡し配達を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am away on weekdays, so I want to receive it in person at my front door on Saturday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request Saturday doorstep handover because you are away on weekdays. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配達区域と空きを確認します。お届け先はこちらの住所で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the delivery area and availability. Is this delivery address correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 合っています。三階の三〇二号室です。建物の入口には呼出しボタンがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所を確認し三階三〇二号室と入口の呼出し設備を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Correct. Room 302 on the third floor. There is a call button at the building entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the address and explain third-floor room 302 and the entrance call system. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 土曜日の午前の便が空いています。入口で三〇二を呼び出せばよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is a Saturday morning slot. Should the driver call room 302 at the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。午前は家にいます。不在でも外には置かず、電話で連絡してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 土曜午前在宅を答え不在時は外置きせず電話連絡を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will be home in the morning. Even if I am out, please do not leave it outside; call me instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm Saturday morning availability and request a call rather than leaving it outside if absent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手渡しの希望と、不在時の電話連絡を受付に記録します。連絡先をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record in-person delivery and a phone call if absent. Please provide your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この携帯番号です。受け取ったときに払うのではなく、今、商品代と配達料を払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯番号を示し商品代と配達料の事前一括払いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This mobile number. Can I pay for the goods and delivery now together, rather than on receipt?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give your mobile number and ask to pay for the goods and delivery together in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらでまとめてお支払いいただけます。配達の控えに日付と連絡先が出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, you can pay both here. The delivery copy will show the date and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今まとめて払います。控えの土曜午前と携帯番号を確かめて、当日は三〇二の呼出しに出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一括支払いを選び控えの日付番号を確認し当日の呼出し対応を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will pay together now. I will check Saturday morning and the mobile number on the copy and answer the call to room 302 on the day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose combined payment, check the copy's date and number, and plan to answer the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご依頼を承りました。土曜日の午前にお届けします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your request is accepted. We will deliver Saturday morning. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そろそろ東の門を閉める時間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: It is almost time to close the east gate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 西の駐車場に車があります。東の門が閉まっても、西へ歩いて行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 西駐車場への園内移動と東門閉鎖の関係を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My car is in the western parking lot. Can I walk west through the park even if the east gate closes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about moving through the park to western parking when the east gate closes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 西の出口は三十分後まで開いています。園内の橋は先に閉鎖します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The west exit stays open another thirty minutes. The park bridge closes first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 橋を使わない道を教えてください。今は池の南側にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池南側から橋を避ける道を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please show a route without the bridge. I am currently south of the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a bridge-free route from the pond's south side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 池の南の道をそのまま進むと、売店の前に出ます。そこで右へ曲がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Continue along the southern path to reach the shop. Turn right there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 売店から右ですね。道の途中に暗い所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 売店での方向を確認し暗い区間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right at the shop, correct. Are any sections dark?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the turn at the shop and ask about dark sections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 木の多い所がありますが、足元の照明は点いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is an area with many trees, but the path lights are on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩いて十五分くらいなら、閉門までに着けそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所要時間と閉門前の到着を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If the walk takes around fifteen minutes, I should arrive before the gate closes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Consider travel time and arriving before closure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通常はそのくらいです。西の出口から駐車場へ直接出られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It usually takes about that long. You can go directly from the west exit to parking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 橋へは行かず、南の道から売店で右へ進みます。今から西の出口へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 橋を避けた経路を決め西出口へ出発する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will avoid the bridge and take the southern path, turning right at the shop. I will head for the west exit now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the route avoiding the bridge and set off for the west exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今の放送についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the announcement just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。次の西町行きは、いつもの二番線ではないのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 西町行きの発車ホーム変更を聞き直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Is the next train to Nishimachi not leaving from the usual platform two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask again about the departure-platform change for Nishimachi. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は三番線から出ます。二番線の線路を点検しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Today it leaves from platform three. The track at platform two is being inspected.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三番線へ行くには、この通路をまっすぐ進めばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三番線までの移動経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: To get to three, do I go straight down this passage?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask the route to platform three. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路の先を右へ曲がってください。同じホームの反対側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Turn right at the end of the passage. It is the opposite side of the same platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 階段を使わずに移れるのですね。発車まで何分ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段なしの移動と発車までの時間を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I can move without stairs. How many minutes until departure?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the route without stairs and time before departure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: あと六分です。三番線の表示にも西町行きと出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Six minutes. The platform-three display also says Nishimachi.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二番線に並んでいる友人にも知らせてから移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二番線にいる友人へ変更を知らせる意思を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will tell my friend who is lining up at two before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your friend at platform two about the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お友達は、こちらから見える方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is your friend someone we can see from here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、青い上着の人です。今呼んで、一緒に三番線へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人の位置を示し一緒に三番線へ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the person in the blue jacket. I will call them now and go to three together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Indicate your friend and move to platform three together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。足元に気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Watch your step and have a good trip.
